faqs.question: What does a workplace technology consultant do?
faqs.answer: A workplace technology consultant helps you decide what to buy, and why, before you commit budget. We translate business goals into a technology brief, compare options across vendors, and give you a costed recommendation for meeting rooms, headsets and workspace platforms.

faqs.question: How long does a consulting engagement take?
faqs.answer: Most engagements move from kickoff to a signed-off recommendation in 4 to 8 weeks. Larger multi-site programmes can continue as retained advisory alongside the rollout.

faqs.question: Can you work with our existing reseller or system integrator?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our recommendation and specification can be delivered through your preferred reseller or system integrator, so you keep existing supplier relationships while gaining an independent view.

faqs.question: Which platforms do you advise on?
faqs.answer: Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, Google Meet hardware and BYOD meeting spaces, plus enterprise headsets and room booking and workspace platforms. We compare hardware from brands including Poly, Neat, Logitech, Yealink and Jabra.

faqs.question: Where in the UAE do you offer consulting?
faqs.answer: We work on-site with organisations across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and the Northern Emirates.

faqs.question: What is a workspace technology audit?
faqs.answer: A structured review of every meeting room, collaboration device and workspace platform you own. It documents what you have, how healthy and well used it is, and what it costs, then turns that into a prioritised action plan.

faqs.question: How long does a workspace audit take?
faqs.answer: Most audits take 3 to 6 weeks, depending on the number of sites and rooms.

faqs.question: Will the audit disrupt our meetings?
faqs.answer: No. Room checks are scheduled around your booking calendar, so meetings carry on as normal.

faqs.question: Do you always recommend replacing equipment?
faqs.answer: No. If a device is fit for another 24 months, we say so. Audits often find savings through reconfiguration, firmware updates or licence clean-up rather than new hardware.

faqs.question: What do we receive at the end of the audit?
faqs.answer: A full inventory, utilisation and licence findings, a refresh-or-retain call for every asset, a prioritised roadmap with business case, and an executive briefing for leadership.

faqs.question: How do we know when it's time to refresh meeting room technology?

faqs.question: Will users lose access to rooms during the refresh?

faqs.question: What happens to our old equipment?
faqs.answer: It is decommissioned and either recycled through a certified e-waste partner or traded in for credit where possible.

faqs.question: Can we change platforms as part of a refresh?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many refreshes include a platform change, such as consolidating onto Microsoft Teams Rooms after a merger. Feature parity, user training and change communications are planned into the programme.

faqs.question: Do you refresh headsets as well as meeting rooms?
faqs.answer: Yes. Headset fleets more than five years old are a common refresh, often combined with persona-based standardisation.

faqs.question: What does a user adoption programme include?
faqs.answer: Persona mapping, a role-based curriculum, short video walkthroughs, quick-reference guides, floor-walker support during go-live, and adoption reviews at 30, 60 and 90 days.

faqs.question: How do you measure user adoption?
faqs.answer: We compare room utilisation and platform engagement data before and after training, rather than counting attendance.

faqs.question: Can you train users on Microsoft Teams Rooms and Zoom Rooms?
faqs.answer: Yes. Content is built per room type and platform, covering how to join, share content, use the touch controller and get help.

faqs.question: Do you support platform migrations?
faqs.answer: Yes. Moves such as Zoom to Microsoft Teams, or Google to Microsoft, need change communications and training alongside the technical cut-over, and we plan both together.

faqs.question: Is training delivered in person?
faqs.answer: Live sessions and floor-walker support are delivered on site at your offices across the UAE, backed by short videos and guides people can use any time.
